summary: Retest of the 2 follow-ups from iteration_307, run on the public URL as cm.coordinator with real AI extraction and fictional TEST_bq8_ data. (1) CUSTOMER SEARCH RACE: FIXED. I used Playwright route interception to make the requests slow (Alphazed 2.5s, Betaquill 1.5s). Case A: let the first query finish, then change the text. The Alphazed results disappeared at once, the dropdown showed 'Searching…' at 0ms and again at +1.0s, and the final list was only Betaquill Club 00-11. Case B: change the text while the Alphazed request is still loading (it gets aborted). 'Searching…' stayed at 0ms, +150ms and +950ms, with no stale results and no early drop of the loading text. The final list was only Betaquill. Fast typing sent 1 request, for the final text only. Typing one character sent no request. Nonsense text showed 'No customers found'. Choosing a customer set '(chosen by coordinator)'. Note: the customer-matcher's '(suggested)' candidate option stays listed during searches, which is by design. (2) DECISION SELECT: FIXED in the UI. On lines flagged 'Not contract-eligible' (Machine matched — Not eligible for maintenance) and 'Already under contract', the decision is 'Exclude' and the 'Include' option is disabled. select_option('accepted') cannot pick it. The approved line still shows 'Matched (exact code)', which is enabled. BACKEND: POST apply with an ineligible line set to {decision:'accepted'} returns 400 '...not eligible for maintenance — exclude it...', and nothing is written. It also returns 400 when an eligible config_id override is sent for that line. An already-covered line set to accepted returns 400 'already under an active contract'. A normal apply returns 200 and creates only the eligible machine. NEW GAP (MEDIUM): an unknown-code line can be accepted with a config_id that points at a contract_eligible:false config. Apply returns 200 and creates equipment for the ineligible machine. The 'unsupported' check only looks at the flags computed at extraction time, and it never re-checks the config chosen by the coordinator. The UI makes this reachable: util/config-search ('Find machine…') returns ineligible configs, and so do the variant buttons.

minor.issue: When d.config_id overrides the match (Find machine / variant pick), the chosen config's eligibility is not checked. An unknown-code line accepted with an ineligible config (contract_eligible False) returns 200 and creates equipment. Fix: after loading cfg for d.config_id, if cfg.get('contract_eligible') is False (or the line's commercial status re-evaluates to not_eligible) and decision == 'accepted', return 400 'not eligible for maintenance'. Do the same for already_covered when there are serials.
Returns ineligible configs with no eligibility field, so the Find machine list cannot mark or hide them.

issues: The Match column still shows 'Machine matched — Price approved' in green on a line excluded as 'Already under contract'. This could be read as ready to price. Low priority.

action_items: MEDIUM: in apply_quote_import, reject decision 'accepted' when the coordinator-chosen config (d.config_id) is contract_eligible False. Optionally filter ineligible configs out of the Find machine / variant options, or mark them.
LOW (optional): soften the green 'Price approved' label on lines excluded as already covered.
critical_code_review_comments: searchCo now bumps st.seq at abort/clearTimeout and clears coResults when a term starts loading. A stale finally block can no longer clear loading. Verified.
apply_quote_import: the eligibility guard relies only on ln.flags from extraction time. A config override bypasses it (see backend minor #1).
AftersalesApp.js is about 3470 lines and should be split. DocumentImportCard would be a natural module to move out.

success_rate.backend: 83% (5/6; the 1 failure is the new config-override gap)
